reason: RenderHookRegistry now accepts the Core-owned RenderHookExtensionInterface and RenderHookContext. Frontend keeps its previous interface and context names as class aliases loaded by Composer in both the aggregate and standalone package, including authoritative classmaps. Existing hooks retain type identity and render unchanged; runtime packages can implement the public hook contract without requiring Frontend. The Frontend Core floor advances to 1.0.79 to ensure these types exist. Registration, placement, cache safety and rendering remain in Frontend.
